failure_policy: Only existing failed/partial logs are copied; missing logs and unverified runs are never filled with synthetic results.
repeat_policy: The r7 T8 repeat and its prior record are separate objects; the prior record is associated with the r6 repeat by job ID. Initial baseline and older history are referenced in the existing r6 public archive.

prior_record_origin.note: Job ID association only; the r6 archive retains the original baseline and older history.

warmup_policy: Warmup logs, linkage and warmup/summary.json are retained separately from timed run results; archive creation does not treat warmup as an additional measured round.
